description: Give every component an ID (a `@coherent-id CID-NNN` comment) and write the /design-system page that lists every token and component with its ID and the pages that use it. Opens an edit that Coherent writes itself; then call coherent_verify_edit level "final" (every page must render exactly as before). Run it after the first build of an app, or when the user asks for the design system. Later edits keep the page current on their own.

root.description: Absolute project root. Defaults to the project this server was started for.
